    StartersDevils on horseback, bacon-wrapped prunesPrunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in bacon and baked crispHow to make it24 pitted prunes100g blue cheese12 rashers of streaky bacon, halved24 toothpicksHeat the oven to 200°C. Stuff each prune with a small piece of blue cheese.Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and secure with a toothpick.Bake until the bacon is crisp.Jail cell cheese strawsTwisted puff pastry strips with parmesan and paprikaHow to make it1 sheet of puff pastry1 egg, beaten80g parmesan, grated1 pinch of paprikaHeat the oven to 200°C and line a tray. Brush the pastry with egg and cover with parmesan and paprika.Cut into thin strips like cell bars.Twist each a few times and lay on the tray.Bake until puffed and golden.MainsRazzle Dazzle deep dish pizzaBilly Flynn's courtroom razzle dazzle: mozzarella, sausage and garlicky tomatoHow to make it500g pizza dough50g butter, melted300g mozzarella, sliced300g Italian sausage, crumbled1 tin of crushed tomatoes2 cloves of garlic60g parmesan, gratedPress the dough mixed with butter into a deep greased tin.Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic.Layer the mozzarella, then sausage, then tomato.Finish with parmesan and bake at 220°C.Rest before slicing.Billy Flynn's Italian beef rollsBilly Flynn's three ring circusHow to make itAs written, serves 4Rare roast beef shaved thin and dunked in garlicky oregano jus, piled into crusty rolls with hot giardiniera and roasted sweet capsicum.Rub a 1.2kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes, then 180°C to 52°C inside.Rest, chill and slice paper thin.Simmer 750ml beef stock with 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 10 minutes.Slice and roast 2 red capsicums.Dunk the beef in the jus and pile into 4 crusty rolls with capsicum and hot giardiniera, spooning over extra jus.SweetsChampagne jellyMister Cellophane's clear sparkling jelly, raspberriesHow to make it5 gelatine leaves150ml water100g caster sugar500ml cold sparkling wine1 punnet of raspberriesSoak the gelatine in cold water.Warm the water with the sugar, squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve.Cool slightly, then gently stir in the sparkling wine.Pour into coupes over raspberries.Chill.DrinksHotel Cicero gin fizzPlenty of ice, unlike Cicero. Gin, lemon and syrup shaken, topped with sodaHow to make it180ml gin100ml lemon juice60ml sugar syrup4 cups ice400ml soda waterMake the syrup ahead by dissolving equal parts sugar and hot water, then cool.Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.Strain into tall glasses over fresh ice and top with soda water.
